title: Directional Lunge
description: This makes the lunge enchant way more powerful, able to lunge in any direction!
body:
This makes the lunge enchantment better, being able to lunge in any direction! However you still lose hunger every lunge, so be careful! This doesn't change the speed of the lunge or the hunger that you get taken from a lunge as well.

Great Tip: You can do **INSANE** mace combos with this mod in your minecraft server or world!

Have fun!

https://discord.com/invite/jtQAdXKnu6 for mod support and talking!
